Name: FishControl
Description:
FishControl is a SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that exposes a token-protected local HTTP control channel. It lets external tools read game state and drive the farmer programmatically.

Installation
1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.
2. Unzip the FishControl folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Configuration
Edit config.json to set your access token. Only requests carrying the correct token are accepted, so keep the token private.

Main features
- Local HTTP control channel bound to your own machine
- Token authentication on every request
- Read game state and drive the farmer

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0.0+
